name: Flickering Grid
description: Canvas grid of tiny squares that randomly flicker in brightness under a radial vignette — a quiet data texture.
a11y: aria-hidden canvas; renders one static frame under reduced motion.
perf: Single 2D canvas; pauses off-screen and in hidden tabs (useCanvas).
prompt: Create a flickering grid background: a DPR-aware canvas filled with square cells; each frame, each cell re-rolls its opacity with probability flicker·dt; masked with a radial vignette. Pause when off-screen/hidden; one frame under reduced motion.

name: Ripple Rings
description: Concentric rings that breathe around a centerpiece — behind avatars, logos, product icons or a CTA.
perf: N absolutely positioned divs with a scale keyframe.
prompt: Build ripple rings: N centered circles with 1px foreground/18% borders and 3% fill, sizes base + i·step, opacity fading outward, each scaling 1→.92→1 over 3.6s with an 80ms stagger; top-to-bottom fade mask.

name: Retro Perspective Grid
description: Synthwave floor grid in 3D perspective scrolling endlessly toward the horizon.
prompt: Create a retro grid: perspective 220px container → rotateX(65deg) plane → oversized child with 60px line-grid background translating Y from −50% to 0 over 15s linear; gradient fade into the background at top and bottom.

name: Particle Network
description: Drifting particles that link with lines when close and gently flee the cursor — the classic network hero.
a11y: aria-hidden; static frame under reduced motion.
perf: Density-scaled particle count; O(n²) links capped by density — keep it to hero areas.
prompt: Build a particle network on canvas: particle count = area × density; particles drift with damping and wrap around edges, are pushed away within 120px of the pointer; draw lines between pairs closer than `link` with alpha (1 − d/link)·.35.

name: Warp Starfield
description: Stars stream out from the center with motion trails; raise `speed` to jump to lightspeed.
a11y: aria-hidden; one frame under reduced motion.
perf: Projected 3D points drawn as lines; trails via translucent clears.
prompt: Create a warp starfield: stars with x,y ∈ [−1,1] and z ∈ (0,1]; each frame z −= speed·dt (respawn at z=1), project to screen as (x/z, y/z)·scale from center, draw a line from the previous projection; clear with a translucent fill for trails.

name: Falling Beams
description: Thin light beams fall down a grid of vertical rails at different speeds — data rain for dev-tool heroes.
a11y: Beams hidden under reduced motion; rails stay.
prompt: Make falling beams: N evenly spaced 1px rails; on each a short vertical gradient (transparent→color→transparent) translates from −30% to 450% on loop with deterministic durations 3–7s and delays.

name: Liquid Waves
description: Layered translucent sine waves undulate at different speeds and lean toward the pointer.
a11y: aria-hidden; static frame under reduced motion.
prompt: Draw layered waves on canvas: for each color, a filled path along y = base + sin(x·.006 + t·(.6+.25i))·(28+8i) + sin(x·.017 − .9t)·10 at 28% alpha, with base offset by the pointer's vertical position.

name: Interactive Boxes
description: A skewed isometric grid of cells that flash random colors under the cursor and fade back slowly.
a11y: Purely decorative; content sits above with pointer-events none on the overlay.
prompt: Build interactive boxes: a large grid of 4rem×2rem bordered cells transformed with skewX(−48°) skewY(14°) scale(.7); on pointerenter set a palette color instantly, on leave fade to transparent over 1.6s; radial vignette over the top.

name: Glowing Dot Matrix
description: Dots near the cursor swell and glow in the accent color while an ambient wave ripples across the matrix.
a11y: aria-hidden; one frame under reduced motion.
perf: One arc per dot per frame; increase `gap` on large areas.
prompt: Create a dot matrix on canvas: every `gap` px draw a dot; t = max(ambient sine wave ·.15, 1 − distance-to-pointer/radius); radius 1 + 2.6t, accent color with alpha .25 + .75t when t > .16, otherwise muted gray.

name: Liquid Shader Gradient
description: A raw WebGL fragment shader paints a slow, liquid, grain-dithered gradient — no three.js, ~1 KB.
a11y: aria-hidden; renders a single frame under reduced motion.
perf: Full-screen triangle, DPR capped at 1.5, paused off-screen/hidden.
prompt: Write a minimal WebGL background: one full-screen triangle, a fragment shader that domain-warps uv·3 with 4 iterations of sin/cos offsets over time, mixes three uniform colors by sin/cos of the warped coords and adds hash-noise grain. Pause when off-screen; DPR ≤ 1.5.

name: Lamp Header
description: Two conic light cones switch on from a glowing bar and illuminate the section heading — the Linear-style lamp.
a11y: Decorative layers; the heading is plain text. Reduced motion: lit immediately.
perf: A few blurred layers widening once on view.
prompt: Create a lamp header: two mirrored conic-gradient cones (from 70° and 290° at center top) masked to fade sideways, widening 8rem→26rem on view; a blurred glow blob and a thin glowing bar at the top; heading overlaps upward with a gradient text fill.

name: Light Through Blinds
description: A shifting warm gradient seen through diagonal glass slats — golden-hour editorial backgrounds.
prompt: Build 'light through blinds': a layer with a repeating 100° stripe gradient (white/7%) over a 300%-sized 3-color gradient whose position animates 0%→100% alternating over 14s with a slight translateX.

name: Topographic Lines
description: Procedural contour-map lines with slowly marching dashes — outdoors, maps and data brands.
a11y: aria-hidden SVG; dashes stop under reduced motion.
perf: Static SVG paths; only stroke-dashoffset animates.
prompt: Generate topographic contours: for i in 0…N build a closed path of points around a center with radius 30 + 22i plus sin(3θ + .7i) and cos(5θ − i) wobble, stretch x by 1.5; stroke with dashes that march at different speeds.

name: Rotating Light Rays
description: Slowly rotating god-rays fan out from above — celebratory 'achievement unlocked' energy.
perf: One repeating-conic-gradient with an animated @property angle.
prompt: Create rotating rays: an oversized layer with repeating-conic-gradient(from var(--angle), color 0 4deg, transparent 4deg 16deg) masked by a radial fade, rotating the registered angle 360° over 40s.
